question: Can the corrected native relation module use100,000 source-bound observed binary properties from its OWN persistent checkpoint to answer unseen entity/action questions, retain earlier relations after subsequent training, and reason safely when some properties are unavailable?
motivation: CKAD02 corrected native representation but supplied property vectors externally. This step closes the actual native property-state↔learned relation interface; it is not a rerun of CKAD01's knowledge-exposure benchmark.

inputs.source_kind: pinned deterministic synthetic simulator ONLY; no authentic real-world causal claim

implementation.change: Optional compact known/value bit planes and source namespace, joined to unchanged NativeContextBasis. Native properties store positive AND negative witnessed values explicitly. Absent knowledge stays UNKNOWN. No external source rows read at inference; no per-entity consequence lookup table.
implementation.admission: Engineering property and consequence namespaces must match. Verified byte pins do not authenticate real-world source. Historical Q/P/Q and original-source modes rejected; no new bridge toWikidata/CausalGym.
implementation.training: Start FULL100k observed properties first, then learn familyC on512 observed consequences at generic degree2. Save native full checkpoint, then learn familyB in a separate native address with same512 entities; C forecasts and all100k facts must remain unchanged.

evaluation.reason: These are source-specific POST-TRAINING observability ablations, not four separate knowledge-scale training runs. Learned relation weights stay identical across conditions. Relevance mapping is evaluator-known from original source, never given as a fitting template.
evaluation.questions: Same2048 withheld entity IDs/seed. Record correct/incorrect/abstain and prediction hashes. Explicitly report new-entity vs novel-feature distinction.
evaluation.controls: Independent exact symbolic GF2 profile from CKAD02 on identical512 observations; enumerate consistent missing-property completions. Fully trained unpruned CART on same10 properties/outcomes; for unknown properties branch BOTH ways and predict only if all possible leaves agree. Retrieval-only abstains on all unseen IDs.
evaluation.cost: Same facts/consequences and common time ceiling, actual fit/infer/metadata costs reported. Different model classes are explicit; no efficiency/superiority claim.

thresholds.native_full: 6144/6144 correct zero wrong; same old C outputs after learningB
thresholds.unknown: No false predictions inany ablation; ZERO must all abstain; irrelevant withholding should retain FULL results if fitted model correctly ignores those features
thresholds.cold: Each complete checkpoint cold-restores in fresh process receiving checkpoint plus entity/action/visibility questions ONLY. Native facts=100000/seed, all original values survive trainingB, numeric relation weights unchanged across observation conditions.
thresholds.controls: Native/independent symbolic every query exact. No advantage expected over strongest equally informed control. CART differences reported without tuning.
thresholds.interpretation: Native engineering development only; source-assumption/simulator-limited generalization. No new externally grounded causal effects or unfamiliar relationship types established.

qualification: Focused native join/provenance/partial/cold/retention negatives first; primary+replication then persisted native checkpoints, mandatory full final root/NKR05 and independent G29 both OS. Continue same isolated branch, one draft PR for wholeCKAD contribution, no merge/deployment.
